name: BankLines
technicalDescription: Bank lines. Since plan r3 stage 2 (03.11) they are a mirror of Priority's screen שורות דפי בנק, written by SyncPriorityBankLines (source priority-mock until the API is connected, priorityLineId, syncedAt; deduped on priorityLineId; bankLineId = PL-<priorityLineId>, or an older file line with the same account, date, amount, payer and reference is adopted instead of duplicated). Only lineType העברה / זיכוי בנק are checked. Lines without priorityLineId came from an uploaded file and stay as they are, view only. Before stage 2: since Iteration 9 they are written by WriteExtractedLines from the reader agent's output (lineNo, sourceRef, rawText for the verify-beside-the-original view) and identified by IdentifyCustomers (checkStage). customerCode/customerName are written when the customer is identified and approved.

columns.name: bankLineId
columns.description: Unique bank line id

columns.name: bankName
columns.description: Bank

columns.name: valueDate
columns.description: Value date

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount ILS

columns.name: payerName
columns.description: Payer name as it appears on the bank line

columns.name: reference
columns.description: Bank reference / free text

columns.name: bankAccount
columns.description: Our bank account the money arrived in

columns.name: lineType
columns.description: Line type. Since plan r3 stage 2 (Priority's bank statement lines): העברה / זיכוי בנק go into the receipt check; פירעון צ׳ק / אחר are shown apart and not handled. צ׳ק / צ׳ק חוזר are kept for the older file lines

columns.name: priorityLineId
columns.description: The line's id on Priority's bank statement lines screen (שורות דפי בנק). The import dedupes on it; empty = an older line that came from an uploaded file (legacy, view only)

columns.name: customerCode
columns.description: Customer the line was assigned to after an approved match (text link to Customers)

columns.name: customerName
columns.description: Customer display name (denormalised)

columns.name: importBatchId
columns.description: Import batch that loaded the line (text link to ImportBatches.id)

columns.name: status
columns.description: Line status: חדשה (written by the file confirm / Priority sync), לא מזוהה, קבלה הונפקה (the receipt was marked issued in Priority). The identify / receipt progress is in checkStage

columns.name: source
columns.description: Data source: priority-mock, priority-file (uploaded Priority export), priority-api, or test-fixture (marked test data, removed by DeleteTestFixtures)

columns.name: syncedAt
columns.description: When this row was last loaded from Priority / the bank file

columns.name: lineNo
columns.description: Order of the line in the file (1-based)

columns.name: sourceRef
columns.description: Where the line sits in the original, e.g. p2:r14 (page 2 row 14) or row 14

columns.name: rawText
columns.description: The line exactly as the reader read it

columns.name: legibility
columns.description: How legible the line was to the reader

columns.name: extractionFlags
columns.description: Check flags, comma-separated: שדה חסר, קריאות נמוכה, כפילות

columns.name: correctedBy
columns.description: Who corrected a field the reader misread

columns.name: correctedAt
columns.description: When the line was corrected

columns.name: checkStage
columns.description: Where the line stands: ממתינה לבדיקה → זיהוי לקוח → ממתינה לאישור (identified, receipt draft) or לא מזוהה → אושרה (IssueReceipt)

columns.name: lastCheckRunId
columns.description: checkRunId of the latest identification run (ReceiptCheckSteps.checkRunId)

columns.name: lastCheckedAt
columns.description: When the line was last checked

columns.name: receiptKey
columns.description: Receipts.receiptKey once the person approved the split (one receipt per transfer)
